findings.issue: Retained baseline owners are not checked against the requested ticket.
findings.disposition: Fixed: validate retained owners against the requested ticket as well as project/source/store; pre-existing defect.

findings.issue: Continuous callbacks indefinitely reset publication debounce.
findings.disposition: Fixed: bound publication delay from the first outstanding request despite continuing callbacks.

findings.issue: Existing automatic worker continues writing after disable.
findings.disposition: Fixed: recheck configuration/installation before automatic writes; retain pending work on disable.

findings.issue: Status fails for a valid registry without publication_request table.
findings.disposition: Fixed: status treats a missing publication-request table as valid empty state.

findings.issue: Automatic path publishes first ledger with missing explicit title.
findings.disposition: Refuted: the downstream required-title guard prevents the claimed successful publication.

findings.issue: Missing-leaf aliases allow ledger and summary destinations to overlap.
findings.disposition: Fixed: resolve existing physical ancestors before rejecting overlapping ledger/summary destinations.

findings.issue: In-flight regression accepts acknowledgement of unseen work.
findings.disposition: Fixed test oracle: assert later work remains pending until processed; reject acknowledgement of unseen work.

findings.issue: Installed state paths silently diverge after YAML path changes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: discover installed state through owned anchors and diagnose configured-path drift.

findings.issue: Subdirectory generation selects process cwd instead of owning configuration root.
findings.disposition: Fixed: resolve generation from the owning configuration root when invoked in a subdirectory.

findings.issue: Configurable work budgets have no practical upper ceilings.
findings.disposition: Refuted: finite caller-selected budgets and a subprocess deadline already bound work; no supported-load failure established.

findings.issue: Publication recovery trusts arbitrary journal artifact destinations.
findings.disposition: Fixed: restrict journal recovery to caller-authorized artifacts and validate physical destinations.

findings.issue: Direct callback transcript path bypasses selected Codex source-store proof.
findings.disposition: Fixed: verify callback transcript membership in the selected source store.

findings.issue: Setup guidance contradicts automatic publication and optional reports.
findings.disposition: Fixed: align setup guidance with automatic publication and optional detailed reports.

findings.issue: True project aliases cannot reinstall or remove owned installation.
findings.disposition: Fixed: use physical project identity consistently for reinstall/removal through aliases.

findings.issue: Installer resolves omitted source store from caller cwd instead of selected project.
findings.disposition: Fixed: resolve omitted source stores from the selected project configuration.

findings.issue: Dangling output symlink bypasses project destination containment.
findings.disposition: Fixed: reject dangling output aliases escaping physical project containment. Discovered during re-review.

findings.issue: Lexical cleaning precedes physical symlink traversal.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preserve physical symlink/parent traversal semantics before canonicalization. Discovered during re-review.

findings.issue: Dangling ledger leaf alias acquires independent publication lock.
findings.disposition: Fixed: derive publication locks from physical target identity for dangling aliases. Discovered during re-review.

findings.issue: Atomic artifact writers replace dangling aliases and strand publication identity.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preserve the resolved target identity during atomic writes through dangling aliases. Discovered during re-review.

findings.issue: Raw source symlink-dotdot traversal bypasses selected Codex store membership.
findings.disposition: Fixed: prove store membership after physical source traversal, including symlink/parent segments. Discovered during re-review.

findings.issue: Installer changes physical source-home semantics before emitting hooks.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preserve physical source-home semantics in installer-generated hook commands. Discovered during re-review.

findings.issue: Installation and binary repair reject release-candidate tags emitted by the repository workflow.
findings.disposition: Fixed: allow workflow RC tags containing + while rejecting unsafe tags; verify installed bundle and repair. Discovered during integration re-review.
